data.gender_notes: Dwithun is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dwithun is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two parts - 'Dwi' meaning 'two' and 'Thun' meaning 'half'. The name is often used to represent the concept of 'two and a half'. The name Dwithun carries the meaning “Two and a half” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Dwithun usually hope their child will grow to embody two and a half and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hinduism, the number 'two and a half' is considered a powerful and auspicious number. It represents the union of two energies and the balance between them. The name Dwithun is believed to bring harmony, balance, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Dwithun belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Two and a half.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dwithun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: In Hinduism, the number 'two and a half' represents a significant concept essential to understanding the deity Ganesha - an important deity in Hinduism. The two elephant's heads on Ganesha represent the dual nature of two aspects - wisdom (Lakshmi) and prosperity (Saraswati) or fearlessness (Courage) and wisdom (Knowledge). The half moon on his head emphasizes his balance between material and spiritual world. So, the name Dwithun holds a unique significance in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, Dwithun can symbolize the balance between two important aspects of life, such as faith and work, love and logic, or material and spiritual pursuits. It also encourages the person to strive for harmony and growth in these areas, as represented by the 'two halves' coming together to make 'two and a half'. Ultimately, the name Dwithun serves as a reminder of the importance of balance and harmony in one's personal growth and spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Dwithun symbolizes the balance and harmony between two aspects of life, represented by the 'Dwit' (two) and 'Thun' (aspects or aspects of the universe). This name encourages one to maintain equilibrium in all aspects of life, fostering inner peace and harmony.
